sourceNote: Official names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them, taken from the Exophase trophy list, which agrees with PSNProfiles on every name, description and grade. Counts PSN tracks are from PSNProfiles. Every guide below is written in my own words from the official description; where a description gives no location or step, the guide says so instead of guessing.

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task for it. Follow the roadmap in order, finish the story, the stranger strands, the activities and the collections, and this lands last.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so start the game and play through it; the trophy unlocks when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Story trophies cannot be missed: keep playing the main missions and each chapter trophy unlocks as its chapter ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. Play the main missions through to the end of the chapter and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story. Play the main missions through to the end of the chapter and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. Play the main missions through to the end of the chapter and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. This is the last story trophy, so it unlocks when the story ends; nothing else is needed for it.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies unlock when the named mission ends; play the story in order and it will come up.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. Play the story in order; the trophy unlocks when the heist mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. Play the story in order; the trophy unlocks when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. Play the story in order; the trophy unlocks when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. Play the story in order; the trophy unlocks when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. Play the story in order; the trophy unlocks when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.guide: Reach 100 percent completion. That means finishing the story, the stranger strands, the activities, the collectibles and the other counted tasks the game tracks; the game's own completion screen is the authority on what is left. Do it after the story, when everything is open, and check the in-game stats as you go.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — completion tracking

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunts are the jumps, near misses and airborne moments the game counts; they add up across free roam, so play naturally and chase stunt jumps when you see them. The count is tracked, so watch it climb in the game's stats.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Exophase — official name, description, grade and the count of 250

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The official description does not name the 9 types, so this guide cannot list them from the list alone; open the activities menu in the game, work through every type it shows, and tick this off when the last one registers.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Exophase — official name, description, grade and the count of 9 activity types
PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. That is every challenge at gold, not just a pass, so expect to replay the harder ones until the gold standard is met. The range is a shooting activity in Leonida; the official list does not give its address, so find it through the in-game map.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: Exophase — official name, description, grade and the count of 42
PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location needs its own win, so a single win is not enough. The official list does not name the 14 spots; work through the drone race locations the game shows and keep a note of which ones you have won.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: Exophase — official name, description, grade and the count of 14 locations
PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different races count, so winning the same race twice does not help; enter new races across Leonida until 20 distinct ones are won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Exophase — official name, description, grade and the count of 20

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is a contact you meet through the story's fishing; challenge him and win the fishing contest. The official list does not say where the challenge starts, so take it when Cal offers it.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade machine in Leonida, play one game through to its end and the trophy unlocks. Any arcade game counts.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is a contact with a mission strand; play his missions in order until the last one ends.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Play Kenton's missions in order until the last one ends.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play Billy's missions in order until the last one ends.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger strands are the side missions strangers offer; finish 8 full strands, not just 8 missions. Keep an eye out for stranger markers as you explore.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: Exophase — official name, description, grade and the count of 8

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's missions in order until the last one ends.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Play Tyrone's missions in order until the last one ends.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. Each spot needs a visit and a meditation, so 17 out of 18 is not enough. The official list does not name the 18 spots; the game marks meditation spots as you find them, so work through them as you explore.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: Exophase — official name, description, grade and the count of 18
PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret is a contact who asks you to hunt one specific animal; take the hunt when he offers it and bring the animal down. The official list does not name the animal or the place, so follow Bret's instructions in the game.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across Leonida; a set is complete only when every card in it is found, and three full sets are needed.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Exophase — official name, description, grade and the count of 3 sets
PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is a photo or check-in style activity at places across Leonida; 100 distinct locations are needed. The official list does not name the spots, so use the in-game map markers and work through them.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Exophase — official name, description, grade and the count of 100
PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's counted tasks; finish any 50 of them and the trophy unlocks. The in-game challenge list shows what is available and what is done.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Exophase — official name, description, grade and the count of 50

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. You need your partner beside you, a 4 star wanted level, and then to lose the cops without your partner going down. Do it while a partner is available in the story; nothing in the official description says it can be missed, but a partner is required, so treat it as a watch item and grab it when the chance is there.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Three robberies in a row, with your partner, while the wanted level stays on the whole time. Plan the route first: pick three shops close together, keep moving, and do not let the cops catch you between robberies. It needs a partner, so do it while one is available; the official description does not say it can be missed.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Discovery means finding and getting into vehicles you have not found before; 100 distinct ones are needed. Drive new cars, bikes, boats and planes as you come across them and the count climbs.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Exophase — official name, description, grade and the count of 100

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-down aiming mode; activate it once and drop 5 enemies before it ends. Pick a busy fight, line the shots up, and do not waste the window.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Exophase — official name, description, grade and the count of 5

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. VCIA is the Vice City airport; leave it in a way the game counts as unscheduled, such as taking off in a plane without following the usual route. The official description does not spell out the exact move, so try a runway departure that breaks the pattern and watch for the pop.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: The official description only says Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the tanks, so this trophy involves them, but the list pins down no step, no place and no number. Expect a tank-related moment in combat or a mission; the exact trigger is not confirmed by the official list, so check the community sources below rather than trusting a single claimed method.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — community findings

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Stealth is the whole task: get in, take the goods and get out without any alarm or witness spotting you. Plan the entry, move quietly, and leave before the store can raise the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five separate vault robberies, each one ending with a clean escape. Vaults are the bigger heist-style robberies; the official list does not name the five banks, so find them through the in-game map and missions.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Exophase — official name, description, grade and the count of 5
PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit an armored truck, take the cash and get away clean. Trucks patrol the roads, so watch for one, strike fast and lose the wanted level after.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Every named area on the map counts; the game tracks which ones you have visited. Drive, fly and walk through the whole state and check the map for gaps.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Exophase — official name, description, grade and the count of 52 areas

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One operation per gang, nine in all; hitting the same gang twice does not help. The official list does not name the operations or the gangs, so find them through the in-game world and keep a note of which gangs you have hit.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Exophase — official name, description, grade and the count of 9 gangs
PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find a bar or spot with a view, and order a cocktail. A quiet one: no combat, just the drink and the view.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle through the showroom frontage and out the other side, in the style of the classic scene. The official list does not name the showroom; pick a vehicle showroom in Leonida and drive out through the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl. The description does not say what score is needed, so play a full game and the trophy should register on the follow-through.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.guide: The official description only says A partnership with mass appeal. That points at a moment with your partner that draws a crowd, but the list gives no mission, no place and no step, so the exact trigger is not pinned down. Watch for a partnership moment in the story and check the community sources below.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — community findings

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSNProfiles tracks a count of 500 for this trophy, so it is about making choices again and again across the game, not one single decision. Keep choosing as options come up in missions, conversations and activities and the count climbs.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — PSN count of 500

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description points at succeeding on a second attempt at something, but it does not say what. Treat it as a watch item: when a moment in the game lets you try again, the success on the second try may be the trigger. Nothing in the official list pins it down further.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description reads like a strange event you stumble into, and it gives no place or step. Explore Leonida, watch for odd events and easter eggs, and the trophy will pop when you witness the right one. The exact trigger is not pinned down by the official list.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. A drive-by using a melee weapon: drive past someone and hit them with a melee weapon from the vehicle. Line the pass up on a quiet road and swing as you go by.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money that has to be cleaned through contacts; keep laundering until the total hits $250,000. It is a slow earner, so start early and keep at it between missions.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Exophase — official name, description, grade and the amount of $250,000

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any spending in shops counts toward the total, so normal play adds up; buy vehicles, clothes and gear as you go and the total climbs.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Exophase — official name, description, grade and the amount of $100,000

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are properties you can buy; all 8 are needed, so save up and buy each one the game offers. The official list does not name the 8 garages, so use the in-game property listings.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Exophase — official name, description, grade and the count of 8 garages
PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the Scooter Bros app to register vehicles you own or find; 10 distinct registrations are needed.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: Exophase — official name, description, grade and the count of 10
